Edit fictional future assumptions

EUR amounts repeat monthly: customer inflow on the 5th, payroll on the 25th, operating outflow on the last calendar day. Unknown tax commitments, total employer costs, loans, investment, fees and interest are gaps in this model, not zero amounts. Payroll is a configurable cash assumption, not calculation of obligations.

Delay suppresses inflows for the first selected months; no catch-up is assumed. Updates are immediate and are not saved after reload.
